interface.shortDescription: Makestar admin queries and guarded Stage order operations.
interface.longDescription: Makestar admin skills for operational lookups and guarded Stage-only order writes through the makestar-admin CLI/binary: auth token acquisition, browser fallback token recovery, admin resource queries, event-to-SKU resolution, SKU inventory checks, order detail inspection, stock allocation, shipping requests, and delivery-prepared changes. Write workflows require an explicit dry-run, exact order authorization, Stage execution gate, readback, and recovery.
defaultPrompt: Resolve event code P_10463_PLAVE_1 to product contents, concrete SKU, and inventory.
